title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
The result is the length of a contiguous substring, not a subsequence.

examples.explanation: Every longer contiguous window repeats b.
wke is the longest valid substring; pwke is not contiguous.

solutionApproaches.title: Restart From Every Position
solutionApproaches.explanation: Grow a unique-character set from each starting index. It is correct but repeats scans over the same characters.

solutionApproaches.title: Sliding Window
solutionApproaches.explanation: Each character is visited once by the right pointer.
